sentences.simplified: 很好，谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: hěn hǎo xièxie
sentences.english: Fine, thanks.

sentences.simplified: 很高兴认识你。
sentences.pinyin: hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ
sentences.english: It's nice meeting you.

sentences.simplified: 你做什么工作？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò
sentences.english: What's your job?

sentences.simplified: 你知道你在做什么吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhīdào nǐ zài zuò shénme ma
sentences.english: What do you think you are doing?

sentences.simplified: 你的衣服是什么颜色？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de yīfu shì shénme yánsè
sentences.english: What color is your dress?

sentences.simplified: 他在她的旁边。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài tā de pángbiān
sentences.english: He is beside her.

sentences.simplified: 他不喜欢吃鱼。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù xǐhuan chī yú
sentences.english: He doesn't care for fish.

sentences.simplified: 都是我的错。
sentences.pinyin: dōu shì wǒ de cuò
sentences.english: It's all my fault.

sentences.simplified: 你喜欢我就高兴。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuan wǒ jiù gāoxìng
sentences.english: I'm glad you enjoyed it.

sentences.simplified: 他也学习汉语。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě xuéxí Hànyǔ
sentences.english: He studies Chinese as well.

sentences.simplified: 你觉得怎么样？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng
sentences.english: What do you think of it?

sentences.simplified: 你认为你能来吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ rènwéi nǐ néng lái ma
sentences.english: Do you think you can come?

sentences.simplified: 你记得她的名字吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ jìde tā de míngzi ma
sentences.english: Do you recollect her name?

sentences.simplified: 我怎么知道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zěnme zhīdào
sentences.english: How should I know.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈准备了好吃的东西给我。
sentences.pinyin: māma zhǔnbèi le hǎochī de dōngxi gěi wǒ
sentences.english: Mother has something delicious in store for me.

sentences.simplified: 我看你不应该。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn nǐ bù yīnggāi
sentences.english: I don't think you ought to.

sentences.simplified: 你应该去看医生。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng
sentences.english: You should see a doctor.

sentences.simplified: 我去我叔叔家。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ qù wǒ shūshu jiā
sentences.english: I am going to my uncle's.

sentences.simplified: 我很愿意。谢谢你。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn yuànyì xièxie nǐ
sentences.english: I do very much. Thank you.

sentences.simplified: 你能告诉我去火车站最近的路吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ néng gàosu wǒ qù huǒchēzhàn zuìjìn de lù ma
sentences.english: Can you tell me the nearest way to the railway station?

sentences.simplified: 我喜欢在图书馆学习。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zài túshūguǎn xuéxí
sentences.english: I like to study in the library.

sentences.simplified: 有的人爱先做难做的工作。
sentences.pinyin: yǒude rén ài xiān zuò nán zuò de gōngzuò
sentences.english: Some people tackle the difficult jobs first.

sentences.simplified: 你明白了吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ míngbai le ma
sentences.english: Do you understand?

sentences.simplified: 我不太清楚。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù tài qīngchu
sentences.english: I'm not really sure.

sentences.simplified: 你会习惯的。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ huì xíguàn de
sentences.english: You'll get used to it.

sentences.simplified: 她把我介绍给她的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ wǒ jièshào gěi tā de péngyou
sentences.english: She introduced me to her friend.

sentences.simplified: 即使你不喜欢这工作，你也得做。
sentences.pinyin: jíshǐ nǐ bù xǐhuan zhè gōngzuò nǐ yě dé zuò
sentences.english: Even though you do not like it, you must do it.

sentences.simplified: 我不明白你的意思。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù míngbai nǐ de yìsi
sentences.english: I can't apprehend your meaning.

sentences.simplified: 他是个有个性的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì gè yǒu gèxìng de rén
sentences.english: He is a man of individuality.

sentences.simplified: 你以为你在跟谁说话？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yǐwéi nǐ zài gēn shéi shuōhuà
sentences.english: Who do you think you're talking to?

sentences.simplified: 他住在学校的宿舍里。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè lǐ
sentences.english: He hangs out in the school dormitory.

sentences.simplified: 他昨天没打扫房间。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuótiān méi dǎsǎo fángjiān
sentences.english: He didn't clean the room yesterday.

sentences.simplified: 他昨天打扫房间吗？
sentences.pinyin: tā zuótiān dǎsǎo fángjiān ma
sentences.english: Did he clean the room yesterday?

sentences.simplified: 你赚了多少钱？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhuàn le duōshao qián
sentences.english: How much money did you make?

sentences.simplified: 一切都会好的。
sentences.pinyin: yīqiè dūhuì hǎo de
sentences.english: Everything will be OK.

sentences.simplified: 我的狗不在旁边我就很寂寞。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de gǒu bùzài pángbiān wǒ jiù hěn jìmò
sentences.english: I feel very lonely without my dog.

sentences.simplified: 这方便得多了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè fāngbiàn dé duō le
sentences.english: It's much more convenient.

sentences.simplified: 是什么使他生病？
sentences.pinyin: shì shénme shǐ tā shēngbìng
sentences.english: What caused his illness?

sentences.simplified: 黑板在教室的前面。
sentences.pinyin: hēibǎn zài jiàoshì de qiánmiàn
sentences.english: The blackboard is in the front of the classroom.

sentences.simplified: 他最喜欢吃的菜是烤鸭。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuì xǐhuan chī de cài shì kǎoyā
sentences.english: His favorite dish is roast duck.

sentences.simplified: 他感冒了。
sentences.pinyin: tā gǎnmào le
sentences.english: He caught a cold.

sentences.simplified: 请帮我喂我的猫好吗？
sentences.pinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ wèi wǒ de māo hǎo ma
sentences.english: Will you feed my cat for me?

sentences.simplified: 你到底是怎么知道的？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ dàodǐ shì zěnme zhīdào de
sentences.english: How on earth did you know it?

sentences.simplified: 你只要问他，他就会告诉你。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhǐyào wèn tā tā jiù huì gàosu nǐ
sentences.english: You have only to ask and he'll tell you.

sentences.simplified: 我们都关心她的健康。
sentences.pinyin: wǒmen dōu guānxīn tā de jiànkāng
sentences.english: We are all concerned about her health.

sentences.simplified: 他的破产和他的妻子很有关系。
sentences.pinyin: tā de pòchǎn hé tā de qīzi hěn yǒuguān xì
sentences.english: His wife had much to do with his bankruptcy.

sentences.simplified: 我爱她就像爱自己的女儿一样。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ ài tā jiù xiàng ài zìjǐ de nǚ'ér yīyàng
sentences.english: I have loved her like a father should.

sentences.simplified: 我觉得这是我的义务。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ juéde zhè shì wǒ de yìwù
sentences.english: I feel it is my duty.

sentences.simplified: 你没拿我的眼镜吧？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ méi ná wǒ de yǎnjìng ba
sentences.english: Don't you have my glasses?

sentences.simplified: 他喜欢拿他的同学开玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐhuan ná tā de tóngxué kāiwánxiào
sentences.english: He likes playing jokes on his classmates.

sentences.simplified: 排球是我很喜欢的运动。
sentences.pinyin: páiqiú shì wǒ hěn xǐhuan de yùndòng
sentences.english: Volleyball is a sport of which I am very fond.

sentences.simplified: 他昨天参加了我们的讨论。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuótiān cānjiā le wǒmen de tǎolùn
sentences.english: He joined us in the discussion yesterday.

sentences.simplified: 我喜欢约翰，他是我非常要好的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan Yuēhàn tā shì wǒ fēicháng yàohǎo de péngyou
sentences.english: I like John, a very good friend of mine.

sentences.simplified: 她和我在学院里是同学。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé wǒ zài xuéyuàn lǐ shì tóngxué
sentences.english: She and I were contemporaries at college.

sentences.simplified: 是的，肯定的。
sentences.pinyin: shìde kěndìng de
sentences.english: Yes, definitely.

sentences.simplified: 是的，当然可以。
sentences.pinyin: shìde dāngrán kěyǐ
sentences.english: Yes, certainly.

sentences.simplified: 我不知道他的动力是什么。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù zhīdào tā de dònglì shì shénme
sentences.english: I don't understand what his motive is.

sentences.simplified: 我不知道他的意图是什么。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù zhīdào tā de yìtú shì shénme
sentences.english: I do not know what his intention is.

sentences.simplified: 你的约会怎么样？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de yuēhuì zěnmeyàng
sentences.english: How was your date?

sentences.simplified: 我姐姐和我都喜欢穿牛仔裤。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiějie hé wǒ dōu xǐhuan chuān niúzǎikù
sentences.english: Both my sister and I like to wear jeans.

sentences.simplified: 我不喜欢我那单调乏味的工作。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐhuan wǒ nà dāndiàofáwèi de gōngzuò
sentences.english: I do not like my monotonous work.

sentences.simplified: 我马上就来。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái
sentences.english: I'll be right with you.

sentences.simplified: 这是他最不可能做的尝试。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì tā zuì bùkěnéng zuò de chángshì
sentences.english: This is the last attempt (that) he would make.

sentences.simplified: 他是我认识的最可憎的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì wǒ rènshi de zuì kězēng de rén
sentences.english: He is the most obnoxious man I know.

sentences.simplified: 你干得很好。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ gàn dehěn hǎo
sentences.english: You did a good job.

sentences.simplified: 她的眼睛湿润了。
sentences.pinyin: tā de yǎnjing shīrùn le
sentences.english: Her eyes moistened slightly.

sentences.simplified: 你刚才指的是什么？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ gāngcái zhǐ de shì shénme
sentences.english: What were you alluding to just now?

sentences.simplified: 他向他的朋友打招呼。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiàng tā de péngyou dǎzhāohu
sentences.english: He saluted his friend.

sentences.simplified: 他的意见没多少影响。
sentences.pinyin: tā de yìjiàn méi duōshao yǐngxiǎng
sentences.english: His opinion doesn't carry much weight.

sentences.simplified: 即使下雨我们也要去。
sentences.pinyin: jíshǐ xiàyǔ wǒmen yě yào qù
sentences.english: We'll go even if it rains.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jièshào wǒ de dìlǐ lǎoshī gěi nǐ rènshi nǐ xiànzài shì guóhuìyìyuán
sentences.english: I'd like you to meet my geography professor. He's in the congress.

sentences.simplified: 我不喜欢读他的文学批评。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐhuan dú tā de wénxué pīpíng
sentences.english: I don't like to read his literary criticism.

sentences.simplified: 看看你都做了些什么！
sentences.pinyin: kànkan nǐ dōu zuò le xiē shénme
sentences.english: Just look at what you've done!

sentences.simplified: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。
sentences.pinyin: wǒmen míngtiān jiāng yīqǐ chī wǔfàn
sentences.english: I'm sorry; I've forgotten your name.

sentences.simplified: 中国历史上有多少个朝代？
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó lìshǐshàng yǒu duōshao gè cháodài
sentences.english: How many dynasties are there in China's history?

sentences.simplified: 这是我给你开的药方。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ gěi nǐ kāi de yàofāng
sentences.english: Here's my prescription.

sentences.simplified: 他是个很难对付的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì gè hěn nán duìfu de rén
sentences.english: He was a difficult man to deal with.

sentences.simplified: 这是本有教育意义的书。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì běn yǒu jiàoyù yìyì de shū
sentences.english: This is an instructive book.

sentences.simplified: 我怀疑，不，我肯定他错了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huáiyí bù wǒ kěndìng tā cuò le
sentences.english: I suspect, nay, I am certain, that he is wrong.

sentences.simplified: 我们对我们的新老师很失望。
sentences.pinyin: wǒmen duì wǒmen de xīn lǎoshī hěn shīwàng
sentences.english: We are disappointed in our new teacher.

sentences.simplified: 你看了关于选举的新闻了吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kàn le guānyú xuǎnjǔ de xīnwén le ma
sentences.english: Have you read the news about the election?

sentences.simplified: 这是我特意为你生日而做的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ tèyì wéi nǐ shēngrì ér zuò de
sentences.english: I made this specially for your birthday.

sentences.simplified: 只要你不出卖我，要我做什么我都愿意。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ bù chūmài wǒ yào wǒ zuò shénme wǒ dōu yuànyì
sentences.english: As long as you don't betray me, I'll do whatever you ask me to (do).

sentences.simplified: 我可以向你保证，你儿子在这里会很快乐的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ xiàng nǐ bǎozhèng nǐ érzi zài zhèlǐ huì hěn kuàilè de
sentences.english: I can assure you that your son will be happy here.

sentences.simplified: 他走了，把所有没做完的工作都留给了我。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒu le bǎ suǒyǒu méi zuòwán de gōngzuò dōu liúgěi le wǒ
sentences.english: He was gone and left all the work undone to me.

sentences.simplified: 他说他会来的，果然来了。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō tā huì lái de guǒrán lái le
sentences.english: He said he would come, and sure enough he did.

sentences.simplified: 你喜欢我的家常菜吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuan wǒ de jiāchángcài ma
sentences.english: Did you enjoy my home cooking?

sentences.simplified: 在来点马铃薯泥好吗？
sentences.pinyin: zài lái diǎn mǎlíngshǔní hǎo ma
sentences.english: Would you like more mashed potato?

sentences.simplified: 我无论如何是会去的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ wúlùnrúhé shì huì qù de
sentences.english: I will go whether or no.

sentences.simplified: 他是个自私自利的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì gè zìsīzìlì de rén
sentences.english: He is a lump of selfishness.

sentences.simplified: 我没心情和你聊天。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi xīnqíng hé nǐ liáotiān
sentences.english: I am in no mood for chatting with you.

sentences.simplified: 我喜欢她眼睛的光彩。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan tā yǎnjing de guāngcǎi
sentences.english: I like the sparkles in her eyes.

sentences.simplified: 他要我问候你。
sentences.pinyin: tā yào wǒ wènhòu nǐ
sentences.english: He asked me to inquire after you.

sentences.simplified: 我乐意和你去。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ lèyì hé nǐ qù
sentences.english: I am willing to go with you.

sentences.simplified: 我确实得走了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ quèshí dé zǒu le
sentences.english: I really have to be going.

sentences.simplified: 今天有多少学生缺席？
sentences.pinyin: jīntiān yǒu duōshao xuésheng quēxí
sentences.english: How many students are absent today?

sentences.simplified: 想吃梨吗？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng chī lí ma
sentences.english: Would you like a pear?

sentences.simplified: 好像要下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: hǎoxiàng yào xiàyǔ le
sentences.english: It looks as if it is going to rain.

sentences.simplified: 我相信你是有见识的人。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ shì yǒu jiànshi de rén
sentences.english: I give you credit for more sense.

sentences.simplified: 她坚决不来。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiānjué bù lái
sentences.english: She was quite adamant that she would not come.

sentences.simplified: 他昨天到达的。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuótiān dàodá de
sentences.english: He arrived yesterday.

sentences.simplified: 你只要一看见她的脸就会明白，她是无辜的。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhǐyào yī kànjiàn tā de liǎn jiù huì míngbai tā shì wúgū de
sentences.english: A glimpse of her face will tell you that she is innocent.

sentences.simplified: 谁都不喜欢被人怠慢。
sentences.pinyin: shéi dōu bù xǐhuan bèi rén dàimàn
sentences.english: No one like to be treated with neglect.

sentences.simplified: 我钱很宽裕，能帮助她。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ qián hěn kuānyù néng bāngzhù tā
sentences.english: As I had plenty of money I was able to help her.

sentences.simplified: 她单独去是很危险的。
sentences.pinyin: tā dāndú qù shì hěn wēixiǎn de
sentences.english: It's unsafe for her to go alone.

sentences.simplified: 他姐姐过去一直指导他，给他出主意，是他的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiějie guòqu yīzhí zhǐdǎo tā gěi tā chū zhǔyi shì tā de péngyou
sentences.english: His elder sister had been his guide, counsellor and friend.

sentences.simplified: 他没注意到她的赞美。
sentences.pinyin: tā méi zhùyì dào tā de zànměi
sentences.english: He does not pay attention her praising.

sentences.simplified: 我可以证明她是诚实的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ zhèngmíng tā shì chéngshí de
sentences.english: I can certify to her honesty.

sentences.simplified: 老师对他的学生非常严格。
sentences.pinyin: lǎoshī duì tā de xuésheng fēicháng yángé
sentences.english: The teacher is very strict with his students.

sentences.simplified: 你一定是在开玩笑吧。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yīdìng shì zài kāiwánxiào ba
sentences.english: You must be joking.

sentences.simplified: 我不太明白，你能再解释一下吗？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù tài míngbai nǐ néng zài jiěshì yīxià ma
sentences.english: I didn't quite follow; could you explain it again?

sentences.simplified: 这对我太合适了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè duì wǒ tài héshì le
sentences.english: Suits me fine.

sentences.simplified: 再见了，很高兴见到你。
sentences.pinyin: zàijiàn le hěn gāoxìng jiàndào nǐ
sentences.english: Good-bye. Nice seeing you.

sentences.simplified: 他哄她同意带她去看电影。
sentences.pinyin: tā hǒng tā tóngyì dài tā qù kàn diànyǐng
sentences.english: He coaxed her into letting him take her to the cinema.

sentences.simplified: 她和他的感受相同。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé tā de gǎnshòu xiāngtóng
sentences.english: She felt just the same as he did.

sentences.simplified: 你愿意当你弟弟的保证人吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yuànyì dāng nǐ dìdi de bǎozhèngrén ma
sentences.english: Are you willing to stand surety for your brother?

sentences.simplified: 那可简化了我的工作。
sentences.pinyin: nà kě jiǎnhuà le wǒ de gōngzuò
sentences.english: That will simplify my task.
